annotations.rfc_basis: RFC 2045 section 5.2: MIME-Version names the MIME version, not a media type; a part with no Content-Type header is text/plain; charset=us-ascii by default. So this part's quote facts are exactly headerless_plain_on_wrote's, and the twin test compares them as data.
annotations.labels_are_typed: every value was typed by a model from the RFC rule and read out of the fixture bytes (a byte/offset listing); never produced by running the library. labels_provenance is spec because a model wrote them, not a person.

annotations.phase_1_facts: document.axes, body.text, body.quote_boundaries, body.view_levels and body.selection.
